scope: Published game.ui.v1 component integration ONLY; deterministic service double, not backend/protobuf implementation proof

cases.name: legacy/unknown version is explicit unsupported capability, not empty v1 success
opaque inventory action IDs and item/instance identities are retained
source interface and ability permissions replace legacy inferred availability
stable bank entries, placeholders, options, tabs and equipment deposits dispatch exact v1 requests
bank drag reorders by entry identity and cancels cleanly on blur or outside release
public chat checks UTF-8 bytes and never optimistically echoes or drops a rejected draft
production single/make-X modes keep menu IDs, reject locked controls and retain failed amounts
native smithing preserves unavailable source rows and sends only declared recipe identities
inventory-only null target renders native controls and preserves authority on reject/cancel
death preview uses actual kept/lost rows and exact monetary strings, not fixture classifications
live recovery projects only real rows and sends discard requests through versioned confirmation flow
malformed nested projections surface errors and cannot dispatch through legacy fallbacks
selected combat style remains identity-bound when projection order changes
declared body-type permissions are respected in character phase without extra cosmetics
reward continuation and confirmation IDs stay authoritative with no local reward/credit grants
unpublished level-up layout bindings remain explicitly incomplete, never a fake quest scroll
